notes.title: Prince of Suburbia: April 24th, 2025 Dev Log
notes.content:
Hey everyone. Thank you for your patience! We'll kick things off with the best news first!

[h3][b]Prince of Suburbia Re-Impregnation "Knock Me Up Again!" DLC
[/b][/h3]
Based on the poll in the previous post, [b]we WILL be sticking with the original style[/b], NOT the new one. I hope that relieves many of you that might have been concerned about it. 

Our artist, [b]auxiliaryout[/b], has been on an absolute tear when it comes to creating art for our brand new upcoming DLC, the [b]Prince of Suburbia "Knock Me Up Again!" DLC[/b]. We're working as quickly as we can to develop this [b]DLC[/b]. The setting we decided on for the [b]DLC[/b] is our lovely harem vacationing at an exotic oasis in the desert with pyramids not far away. Will they have a relaxing vacation or will trouble find them?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3593230/Prince_of_Suburbia__Knock_Me_Up_Again/

We're excited to announce we have our [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3593230/Prince_of_Suburbia__Knock_Me_Up_Again/]store page up on Steam[/url][/b] (as you can also see in the graphic above) and if it looks appealing to you, we'd love it if you would wishlist it! We plan on having at least one mini-release on Patreon/SubscribeStar for this DLC in the near future as we develop it so that you can check it out as we go and let us know what you think!

Please enjoy the screenshots showing off some of the new outfits for the vacation and post-pregnancy bodies. Check out the store page to see the rest of your favorite harem!

[h3][b]Prince of Suburbia Pregnancy DLC[/b][/h3]

Unfortunately, not much progress has been made on the Prince of Suburbia Pregnancy DLC since the last actual progress for it was announced. We were close to having a mini-release for it but we had multiple delays with art production which plagued development progress for the Pregnancy DLC. We ended up parting ways with vesperanoita and wish her the best. 

We have a new artist already working for us that will be taking on the effort. We'll share more with you as we progress with development.

[h3][b]A Shot in the Dark Development[/b][/h3]

Being honest, we're still not sure when we'll be able to get back to ASitD development and we don't want anyone to have any high hopes that will change anytime soon given our current circumstances. If you missed why this is currently going on with A Shot in the Dark please check out an earlier post below.

https://www.patreon.com/posts/january-30th-dev-120902569

Chapter 4 is the halfway point of the story. After deliberation we have decided we'll probably call it Part 1, Season 1, or something to that effect as it remains paused. We have translation work we already completed for it so we'll do our best to implement that too for fans that have been waiting for the other languages. The game's development will continue to remain paused/on hold.

notes.title: Prince of Suburbia: Pregnancy DLC Update
notes.content:
It's been a hot minute since we talked about our future plans for [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] with all of you, hasn't it? We appreciate your patience in waiting to hear about what's next.

Let's start off with the unfortunate news first. For those that don't already know, we parted ways with [b]auxiliaryout[/b] (the most recent artist and animator for [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i]) a few months after the release of [b]V1.0[/b] (the end of the main story). He is a talented artist and animator and we wish him the best of luck with his future endeavors!

So, that brings us to the next order of business. We are looking for a new illustrator and animator to help us continue the [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] story with a [b]Pregnancy DLC[/b]! 

We've spent a lot of time reflecting in the past year about what players want and expect when they play [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i], and how to deliver the best experience possible. With that in mind, our two priorities when it comes to the future art for [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] are:
[list]
[*] An illustrator who specializes in MILFy type characters (aka BIG BOOBAS), big belly pregnancy, and adult breastfeeding/milky breasts content.
[*] An animator who specializes in Spine. The main game was animated using Live2D, and we feel like we pushed it to its absolute limits in terms of quality. Our understanding is that Spine has a higher ceiling in terms of quality and we want to explore that potential.[/list][b]Do you have any illustrators or animators you'd like to suggest we reach out to? Let us know![/b]

We have also obviously been compiling our own list of artists we want to approach. Once we have a shortlist of artists we want to audition, we'll commission a few illustrations/animations from them and seek input from our community before moving forward.

This is your chance to help shape the future [b][i]Prince of Suburbia[/i] Pregnancy DLC[/b]! We look forward to sharing more news with you as things develop, stay tuned!

notes.title: V1.0 update has released!
notes.content:
[h1]The V1.0 update is now available![/h1]
The update has been made to both [b]Part 1[/b] and [b]Part 2[/b] of [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i]. Thank you to all of you that entered our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1896170/announcements/detail/3799410647390921666?snr=2_9_100003_]Global Steam Key Giveaway[/url]! Winners will be contacted by DM on Steam today.

[h1]Note: Saves will be broken.[/h1]
[quote][b]V1.0[/b] is a game-breaking update. We made major changes to the code with this update, including brand new GUI and upgrading to Ren'Py 8+. If your saves are broken, clicking Start in the main menu will give you a few options for different jump in points so you don't have to start from the beginning.

Using old saves, even if they open without error, may cause errors later on. Please consider starting a new game or use one of the jump in points in the title menu rather than opening old saves.[/quote]
If you have any other trouble accessing the game or encounter any bugs or issues, please let us know!

The final update ([b]V1.0[/b]) of [b]Prince of Suburbia[/b] includes:

[h3]NEW CONTENT:[/h3][list]
[*] ~20,000 words
[*] 39 illustrations
[*] 23 animations
[*] 33 voice acting files (thanks to HaruLuna)
[/list]
[h3]REMASTERED CONTENT:[/h3][list]
[*] 16 illustrations
[*] 8 animations
[*] 115 voice acting files (thanks to HaruLuna)
[*] brand new GUI (thanks to m. of Tsundere Studio)
[/list]
[h3]THANK YOU to everyone who helped with this update:[/h3][list]
[*] m. of Tsundere Studio for the brand spanking new GUI
[*] auxiliaryout, for all the art and animations
[*] HaruLuna, for the amazing voice acting
[*] Rachel Writes and Yvlan_Angel for their writing help
[*] Our play testers for this update: Doc62, EDHPlayer, Hondo, NeverAtone, Saniya
[*] All of the generous volunteers who helped improve the translated and localized versions
[/list]
[h1]What's next for Prince of Suburbia?[/h1]
[b]V1.0[/b] completes [b]Part 2[/b] and the main story of [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i]. We want to make sure there are no major bugs or issues in the game (especially in the translated/localized versions) before we leave Early Access on Steam, but that is our next goal. The plan is to work on that in early 2024.

After [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] has left Early Access on Steam in early 2024, we will begin development on the additional [b]Pregnancy DLC[/b] content. Stay tuned for more on that next year!

notes.title: Prince of Suburbia: V1.0 Update + Dev Log
notes.content:
[h1]V1.0 is almost here![/h1]
We're thrilled to announce that the [b][i]Prince of Suburbia[/i] V1.0[/b] update is almost here, with the base (English-only) version scheduled to be completed this month! The much-anticipated Steam release will follow about a month later, in November, when the translated and localized versions are complete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/15b0c4ce0dba99ec164184edb6ec4d454dd4dc92.png[/img]
[h1]New and remastered content[/h1]
[b]V1.0[/b] is a significant update, featuring the most extensive free roam content we've ever included in the game. We hope that this update will be a satisfying ending to the [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] story!

notes.title: Prince of Suburbia: March Dev Log, Progress Update & Previews
notes.content:
[h2]Part 2 (paid DLC) currently on sale until April 3![/h2]
The [b]Spring Sale[/b] has been extended! You can still purchase [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2149280/Prince_of_Suburbia__Part_2/][b][i]Prince of Suburbia[/i] - Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b][/url] for [b]10% off through April 3[/b]. Buy it today!

[h2]Frequently asked questions[/h2]
Here are some questions we get frequently from our players on Steam!

[h3]What updates are planned for Part 2 (paid DLC)?[/h3]
[list][*] The [b]first beach update (V0.9)[/b] was already added to the game last month. This update was free for all players who had previously purchased the [b]Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b].
[*] The [b]second beach update (V0.95)[/b] will be the second free update to the [b]Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b]. It will also be free for all players who have previously purchased the [b]Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b]. It's estimated release on Steam is late Spring 2023.
[*] The [b]last update to the main story (V1.0)[/b] will be the last free update made to the [b]Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b]. It is estimated to release in the second half of 2023 and will be free for all players who have previously purchased the [b]Part 2 DLC[/b].[/list][h3]When will the game leave Early Access? Will the price increase?[/h3]
Once all of the remastered art and voice acting has been added to both [b]Part 1 (free demo)[/b] and [b]Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b], the game will move from [b]Early Access[/b] to full release. Our plan is for the game to leave [b]Early Access[/b] later in 2023.

A price increase for [b]Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b] will likely happen at this point, more details to follow as we approach this transition. 

[h3]Are there any plans for a Part 3?[/h3]
After we wrap up the main story with the [b]V1.0[/b] release, we plan to have [b]additional DLC content[/b] with all of the characters, including pregnancy content. These DLCs will not continue the main story, they will be standalone scenes that take place outside of the main story. [u]No Part 3 of the main story is planned.[/u] 

Stay tuned for more information about additional DLCs later in 2023!

[h2]Progress continues on the second beach update![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/e838049f6b682f00d5b19a4a47c7e4fc030141a7.png[/img]

Art for the [b]second beach update (V0.95)[/b] of [b][i]Prince of Suburbia[/i] - Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b] is progressing on schedule! 

With the writing wrapping up for the next update of our other game, [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1853830/A_Shot_in_the_Dark/]A Shot in the Dark[/url][/b][/i], our team will be able to shift focus to [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] so we should see more progress on the writing in April. We are also looking to hire an additional writer or two to potentially help with this and/or future updates.

One of our team members who works on [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] has had a health emergency and will be taking the month of April off. If this causes any delays with the [b]V0.95[/b] development cycle, we will keep players updated. We did not anticipate releasing [b]V0.95[/b] in April anyway, so it's too soon to say if there will be an impact beyond that. We wish our team member a healthy and speedy recovery!

We are already planning ahead for the artwork and remastered scenes in [b]V1.0[/b] (the last update of the main story). Ideally, we'd like to get ahead on art so that our artist and animator can take a much-needed break to rest and heal his hand between the main game and the pregnancy/epilogue content we have planned for later this year or early next year.

If there are any delays with the release of [b]V0.95[/b], a silver lining is that it will likely allow us to include some of the remastered art planned for [b]V1.0[/b] in the [b]V0.95[/b] release so that we can sooner reach our goal of a fully remastered game and moving out of [b]Early Access[/b]!

The [b]V0.95[/b] update includes the most complex art we've ever attempted, and we are certain it will be worth the wait! Attached to this post are some previews to whet your appetite. ;)
